title: Shrinking-partition neighborhoods and stabilizing least-index selectors
statement: Let $S$ be a compact metric totally disconnected space in the universes of [def-weil-size-convention]. Let $A_j$ be closed subsets covering $S$, indexed by positive naturals. Suppose $P_i$ are refining finite partitions of $S$ with clopen atoms of diameter $<(1/2)^i$. Set $U_{j,i}$ to be the union of the atoms of $P_i$ meeting $A_j$. Then these sets are clopen, decrease in $i$, and have intersection $A_j$. There exist locally constant maps $k_i:S\to\{j:1\le j\le i\}$ which select the least $j\le i$ with $s\in U_{j,i}$, or return 1 if none exists. For every point $s$, these maps are eventually equal to the least index $j_0$ with $s\in A_{j_0}$. Empty $S$ and empty members of the cover are allowed.

proof.text: Define U_(j,i) by the stated finite union. It contains A_j, is clopen, and decreases because every fine atom lies in a coarse atom. For a point outside A_j choose a ball in the open complement and a level whose atom diameters are smaller than its radius. No atom containing that point meets A_j. This proves that the intersection of U_(j,i) is A_j.

Use PNat.find on the predicate j<=i and s in U_(j,i), or use the default 1 when the predicate has no witness. Its specification proves both selection clauses. On each open partition atom, all U-membership predicates are unchanged, by uniqueness of an atom containing a point. The least eligible index is thus constant on each open atom, and defines a locally constant map.

The cover supplies a least index j_0 for each point. For every j<j_0 the intersection identity supplies some level excluding the point from U_(j,i). Decreasingness keeps it excluded at every larger level. Induction over the finite interval [1,j_0) gives a common exclusion bound. Beyond its maximum with j_0, j_0 is eligible and every smaller index is excluded; the least-index specification therefore forces k_i(s)=j_0. The finite interval can be empty, so the case j_0=1 is included.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_closedCover_selectors
    (S : Type u) [MetricSpace S] [CompactSpace S] [TotallyDisconnectedSpace S]
    (A : ℕ+ → Set S) (hclosed : ∀ j, IsClosed (A j))
    (hcover : (⋃ j, A j) = Set.univ)
    (P : ℕ+ → Finpartition (Set.univ : Set S))
    (hclopen : ∀ i p, p ∈ (P i).parts → IsClopen p)
    (hdiam : ∀ i p, p ∈ (P i).parts → Metric.diam p < (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (i : ℕ))
    (hrefine : ∀ i, P (i + 1) ≤ P i) :
    ∃ U : ℕ+ → ℕ+ → Set S,
      (∀ j i, U j i = ⋃ (p : (P i).parts) (_ : (p.val ∩ A j).Nonempty), p.val) ∧
      (∀ j i, IsClopen (U j i)) ∧
      (∀ j i, U j (i + 1) ⊆ U j i) ∧
      (∀ j, (⋂ i, U j i) = A j) ∧
      ∃ k : ∀ i : ℕ+, LocallyConstant S {j : ℕ+ // j ≤ i},
        (∀ i s,
          ((∃ j : ℕ+, j ≤ i ∧ s ∈ U j i) →
            s ∈ U (k i s).val i ∧
              ∀ j : ℕ+, j ≤ i → s ∈ U j i → (k i s).val ≤ j) ∧
          ((∀ j : ℕ+, j ≤ i → s ∉ U j i) → (k i s).val = 1)) ∧
        ∀ s, ∃ j₀ : ℕ+,
          s ∈ A j₀ ∧ (∀ j : ℕ+, s ∈ A j → j₀ ≤ j) ∧
          ∃ i₀ : ℕ+, ∀ i : ℕ+, i₀ ≤ i → (k i s).val = j₀
